actual_model: Not independently observable; seat assignment is parent-reported.
scope: Adversarial final static review of canonical semantic retention, formal/implementation boundary and acceptance evidence. No production edits or Maven execution.

findings.title: Required canonical adapter acceptance fixtures are missing from reviewed tests
evidence: spec/implementation-g1.json acceptance requires dependent-domain rejection/unbound references and injective namespace/order/arity fixtures plus exact embedding bytes.

backend/src/test/java/dev/allow/canonical/CanonicalizerTest.java covers signature/field/predicate/binder renaming, shadowing, multiplicity, operand order, facts/scope and unsupported syntax, but has no dependent-domain fixture, unbound ExprVar fixture, direct namespace/arity encoding check or independent exact feature vector oracle.

backend/src/main/java/dev/allow/canonical/ExpressionEncoder.java:153 processes domains before allocating current binders and therefore appears to support preceding-scope dependency; this behavior needs a regression rather than reliance on the fixed-payload theorem.
findings.disposition: Before claiming all canonical acceptance gates passed, add focused fixtures and run them, or list these gates as pending. Let-scope testing is additionally recommended.

findings.title: Lean model proofs do not certify Java structural grammar or parser correspondence
evidence: formal/Allow/Slots.lean:33-61 defines anonymous as the fixed resolved payload projection; name/source invariance follows without parsing or JSON serialization.
formal/Allow/Slots.lean:14-31 uses a smaller abstract tree/operator vocabulary than spec/slot-profile.json; no refinement mapping to Java positional JSON is checked.
gates/g1/formal-report.json labels theorem rows PROVED_MODEL; spec/implementation-g1.json proof_boundary and README.md explicitly exclude Java/React refinement and parser correspondence.
findings.disposition: Preserve these scope statements. VERIFIED in the formal report is model verification only; neither feature similarity nor structural equality is a universal semantic-equivalence certificate.

observations: SlotRegistry uses IdentityHashMap and source traversal counters, not spelling or name hashes; bound counters are globally fresh and lexical visibility is restored.

ModuleEncoder rejects unsupported signature and declaration attributes, imports, macros and temporal/incremental command fields; includes facts, function bodies, signature/field domains and selected command scope. No confirmed semantic-loss pair found in this static review.

AnonymizedArtifact construction is package restricted; production encoder call sites construct tags from fixed literals and checked operator names. This is Java package discipline, not a formally verified closed algebraic datatype.
EmbeddingEncoder matches the documented chunk hashing/count/L2 algorithm on inspection; feature collisions are expected and cannot justify equality.
Canonicalizer catches UnsupportedCanonical into empty payload/hash/features; no source-text fallback is present.
trust_limits: Static review of the hashed files only; no new Java tests, parser experiments, Lean builds or Maven builds were executed by this seat.
Tests or code added concurrently after these hashes require separate final test evidence.
No assertion of universal canonical injectivity, semantic preservation, security, anonymization against structural identification, or completion of all G1/G2 acceptance gates.
JSON scalar coercion and untrusted UI reference-drop issues were assigned elsewhere and are not duplicated here.

evidence: backend/src/test/java/dev/allow/canonical/SlotBoundaryTest.java adds six tests covering dependent-domain renaming and semantic distinction, let shadowing, unbound identity rejection, scope restoration/nonreuse, signature versus bound namespaces, field arity, tags/order/null framing, and exact byte/hash/feature oracle.

/tmp/allow-g1-final-build.log reports SlotBoundaryTest six passed and CanonicalizerTest eleven passed; overall backend 37 passed, frontend 16 passed, 0 Checkstyle violations, 49 JS/TS and 13 Java checker fixture cases passed.

Matches the checked-in test.
final_disposition.interpretation: Initial finding retained above as review history. Focused fixtures now discharge this evidence gap for tested cases. No universal parser refinement, structural injectivity or security proof follows. Other G1/G2 acceptance gates remain outside this disposition.
final_disposition.execution_boundary: Read test source and build log; independently recomputed Python oracle. Did not invoke Maven or rerun Java/TypeScript tests.
